alkylation reagent: A carboxyamidomethylated cysteine building block was used to eliminate the need for cysteine modification prior to MS analysis.
cleavage agent: three different sets of peptides were created or used in this study... tryptic peptides representing essentially all canonical human gene products
collision energy: HCD scan with 28% normalized collision energy and Orbitrap readout... CID scan with 35% normalized collision energy... consecutive HCD scans at 20, 25 and 30 normalized collision energy
fractionation method: The resulting 96 measurement pools were desalted on C18 material (Waters, SepPak) before storage at -20 °C.
fragmentation method: HCD scan... CID scan... ETD scan... EThcD scan... ETciD scan
instrument: The HPLC system was coupled on-line to an Orbitrap Fusion Lumos mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
labeling: no labeling strategy is mentioned for sample-linked proteomics runs
